title: Dassault Systèmes PLM PoC
subTitle: Proof of concept for a PLM rollout — Engineering Orders and BOM
overviewContent: Took part in a proof of concept for a Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system at Dassault Systèmes, supporting development of the core functionality — Engineering Orders (EO) and Bills of Materials (BOM) — by customising the Enovia solution. The PoC validated system requirements and feasibility ahead of the full rollout, which I later worked on at Hyundai Mobis.

jd: Supported the development of Engineering Order (EO) pages by customising the Enovia solution.
Assisted in creating and maintaining Bills of Materials (BOM) and Engineering Orders (EOs).
Contributed to documenting testing scenarios, system documentation, ERDs, and end-user guides.
